artworks.title: Village beside a Canal
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river in the foreground, leading to a village with houses along its banks. The horizon is low, showing windmills and trees in the distance. The image uses fine linework with cross-hatching and light strokes, resembling etching or engraving techniques. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of ink to create depth and detail.

artworks.title: Village beside a Canal
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.4 x 21.1 cm (4 7/8 x 8 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with fields, trees, and a body of water. Figures are by the water, engaging in activities like fishing. In the distance, there are buildings, windmills, and small details. The artwork is in black ink on a pale background, with detailed linework.

artworks.title: Caernarvon Castle (Night)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and lift-ground aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts Caernarvon Castle at night, seen from across the water. A path with people and a horse runs along the riverbank. The moonlight reflects on the water, with clouds partially obscuring the moon. The castle dominates the middle of the composition, with visible towers and walls. In the distance, there is a small fire burning. Rich sepia tones and chiaroscuro techniques are used to create a moody atmosphere. Fine brushstrokes detail both the landscape and the castle.

artworks.title: Portrait du Caravage (Portrait of Caravaggio)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 22.8 x 13.5 cm (9 x 5 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man's back and three-quarters upper body view. He is standing and slightly leaning forward, holding a mirror in front of him at chest level reflecting his face. The man's facial features as seen in the mirror include a full beard and a mustache, with his eyes looking upwards. His hair appears short and closely cropped from the back. He wears a loose, tattered robe that reveals signs of wear with frayed edges. Beside him is an object resembling a human skull on a flat surface. The background is a simple dark texture with no discernible details.

artworks.title: Two Seated Women
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures seated closely together. The person on the left has wavy hair neatly styled back and distinct facial features. They are wearing intricately designed garments with flowing sleeves and a visible chain or necklace. The person on the right has hair partially covered with a draped cloth, and subtle facial features. This person seems to be holding an object resembling a small book or tablet. Both figures are engaged in a shared activity or discussion. The background is an abstract blend of clouds and ethereal shapes. The figures and their attire are finely sketched with intricate details.

artworks.title: Two Recumbent Sheep
artworks.description: The image displays two sheep resting on the ground. One sheep faces us, while the other is turned away. Shrubs or low bushes are faintly visible in the background. The artwork is done in an etching style with intricate lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color scheme is black and white, highlighting the detailed linework and light-shadow interplay. Horizontal lines in the background suggest a simple backdrop.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape with a Bridge
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 12.5 x 14.6 cm (4 15/16 x 5 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a wooded landscape with trees dominating the composition. In the foreground, there is a stream or pond with vegetation, and a wooden bridge crosses it. The etching depicts detailed foliage, a group of figures walking on a path, and a softly etched sky with light cloud cover.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.artist: Flemish 17th Century, style of Albrecht Dürer
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 24.1 x 17.9 cm (9 1/2 x 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene set in a wooded area with figures interacting around an inanimate figure. The forested area is filled with figures engaged in various activities around a central figure lying down, surrounded by others. The detailed shading and textures in the foliage, twisted trees in the background, an angelic figure in the top left, and elements of skulls and flowers contribute to the overall atmosphere of the artwork.

artworks.title: Two Children Petting a Lamb
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from two blocks: black line block and blue tone block on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an image showing three grayscale figures in a natural setting. The figures appear to be interacting, with two leaning over another, potentially holding an object. The style resembles classical or Renaissance etchings, featuring strong contrasts and emphasis on form. The artwork is predominantly monochrome using shades of gray and black, with detailed hatching for texture and depth in the figures and foliage. The intricate foliage framing the composition indicates an outdoor environment. The etching creates an intimate space, focusing the viewer's attention on the central figure's interaction.

artworks.title: The Cow in the Swamp
artworks.description: The image shows a cow partially hidden in dense vegetation. The scene is viewed from a slightly elevated position, with foliage obscuring the horizon. The background is filled with plants and trees reaching into the sky. The artwork is detailed, using intricate etching to emphasize textures. The color palette is mainly shades of gray and black, creating a monochromatic appearance. Darker tones are used for depth and shadows. The vegetation is highly detailed, creating a lush atmosphere where the cow blends in naturally.

artworks.title: The Fight between Ulysses and Irus
artworks.artist: Jan Muller, after Cornelis Cornelisz van Haarlem
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an architectural setting. It depicts several muscular figures in dynamic poses. The central focus is a robust, nude male figure with his back to the viewer. Surrounding figures are clothed and appear to interact with the central figure. Another figure in the foreground appears to be reclining. The background features classical architecture with columns and a dome structure. The figures are detailed with lines and shading, conveying movement and vitality.

artworks.title: Seated Warrior Holding a Sword and Shield [recto]
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on gray-blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a full-body drawing of a person in a sitting position. The individual is reclining slightly backward, with the head tilted upwards and the gaze directed above. The facial features suggest a firm expression with a slightly open mouth, while the hairstyle is short and close to the scalp. The person is wearing a draped garment, possibly resembling a toga or a robe, loosely covering the body and falling in soft folds. They hold a large round shield with a floral or medallion-like pattern in one hand, and the other hand is partially obscured but appears to grasp a long stick or weapon, potentially a spear. The background is plain, lacking any discernable environmental elements, which emphasizes the subject.

artworks.title: Clasped Hands [verso]
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on gray-blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of intertwined hands. The drawing depicts two hands interlocking. The image shows a focus on the texture of the skin and varying shades for depth and realism. The hands are detailed with veins and prominent knuckles. The background is minimally detailed to keep the focus on the hands.

artworks.title: An Ornate Ceiling with an Allegory of Spring
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over graphite on faintly blued-green laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceiling design. The central feature is a circular medallion with classical motifs and mythological figures surrounded by decorative patterns. The design includes ornate borders separated by gilded lines, creating symmetry and detail. There are fresco-like frames in the corners and other sections with additional figures and ornamental details, reminiscent of neoclassical style. The colors are muted, enhancing the classical theme.

artworks.title: Rustic Watermill in a Gothic Ruin
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a watermill building in a state of disrepair, surrounded by elements of nature and human activity. The background features a distant church and trees, hinting at a village setting. The detailed brushstrokes depict architectural and natural features accurately. The color scheme consists of earth tones, greens, and blues. Figures, including a woman, children, and a dog, are shown near the water, engaging in daily activities. Additional figures can be observed among the trees and by the building, adding to the depiction of rural life against a historical backdrop.

artworks.title: Hudson River, Logging
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This painting shows a body of water in between wooded mountains. On top of the water there are several long wooden logs with people on them. One of the people stands atop a large log, while the other appears to sit or recline. The people both wear hats, and one of them holds a long stick with a pointed end. The water is a vibrant blue, and the logs are in shades of brown, tan, and yellow. The forest behind the water has trees in shades of dark and light green. The sky has clouds in white and gray against a blue background. The brushstrokes in the artwork are loose, and some of the colors bleed into one another.

artworks.title: Wagtail, Eagle, and Turtledove
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is an image of three birds. It shows an eagle in the center, with two smaller birds on either side. The background displays mountains, buildings, and trees. The drawing is detailed, emphasizing the feathers and features of the birds and the scenery. The labels "Aquila," "Parus," and "Turtur" are placed above the birds. Depth is created by layering mountains and clouds in the background. The drawing showcases classical elements and meticulous texture typical of wildlife illustration.

artworks.title: Sawbill, Bittern, Heron and Teal
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three birds near a body of water with reeds. The artwork features two larger birds standing on the ground and one smaller bird sitting on the ground. The background shows tall grass or reeds and bodies of water. The illustration has detailed line work showing texture on the birds' feathers and surrounding foliage.

artworks.title: Double-Wattled Cassowary and Finches
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white illustration of various birds in a landscape setting. The detailed line work depicts the scene from a slightly elevated perspective. Three birds are on the ground, including a large bird with elongated legs and neck, and two smaller birds. In the background, a village is on a hillside with buildings and a water body with a bridge. Figures are crossing the bridge, and two birds are flying in the sky. The engraving uses hatching and intricate line work to show texture and shading.

artworks.title: Falcon and Robin Redbreast or Redstart
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving focusing on three birds in a natural landscape. A large bird, possibly a hawk, is perched on a branch, facing right with intricate feather details. Two smaller birds are also present. The sky has horizontal cloud etchings, with hills and a structure in the background. Buildings with unique roofs, a watermill, and trees are on the right side. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of gray, emphasizing texture and shading typical of engravings.

artworks.title: Hoopoe and Owl
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a print of a bird flying over a distant landscape alongside an owl perched on a branch. The bird on the left is in mid-flight, facing the right. It has stripes on its body and wings, a pointed head, and a long beak. On the right, an owl is perched on a branch that rises from the lower right corner. The owl has dotted feathers on its body and its wings pulled in by its sides. Its beak is slightly hooked, and its head is slightly turned to the left. There are small dark words beside each bird. The background shows a town far below, with buildings, roads, and bridges leading over a winding river. There are people and animals walking across the land and standing in boats on the water. In the background there are distant hills.

artworks.title: Heron and Snipe
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts two birds labeled "Ardea stellaris major" and "Rallus" in intricate detail. The birds are shown in a landscaped area with vegetation, flowers, and textured ground. In the background, there is a town with buildings, spires, and boats near the water. The sky has swirling clouds. The engraving is primarily monochromatic, using varying shades of grey to create depth and texture.

artworks.title: Two Giant Snipes and Two Surf Scoters
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various birds by a body of water surrounded by tall grasses. The drawing depicts a scene with birds in their natural habitat beside a water body with tall reeds or grasses. One large bird with long legs and a long neck stands prominently in the foreground, while several other smaller birds are seen both on land and in the water. The background shows more birds flying in the sky and several more on the water. The illustration showcases detailed plant life, with each blade of grass meticulously rendered. Shadows and textures are created with fine lines and hatching, typical of traditional engraving or etching techniques.

artworks.title: Mallard, Duck, and Swallow
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three birds in a landscape setting. The image includes a duck labeled "Anas" on the left, a swallow labeled "Hirundo" in the center, and another duck labeled "Anas marina" on the right. The background features a landscape with a town in the distance, including church spires, houses, and hills. The scene is filled with grassy patches, trees, and details creating depth and tranquility. The drawing appears to be an etching or engraving, indicated by the fine lines used to portray the birds and landscape.
